collapse_declaration: Three-group water data declared for the FiR 1 cylindrical-phantom depth-profile check: groups match the declared beam histogram bins (fast 1e4-1.69e7 eV, epithermal 0.5-1e4 eV, thermal 1e-5-0.5 eV). H1/O16 pointwise sigma_s and sigma_a evaluated from the processed ENDF/B-VIII.1 294K library (the same library the OpenMC validation run consumed) at representative group energies; thermal values at 0.0253 eV. Within-group self-scatter carries the elastic component; downscatter removal g0->g1 and g1->g2 follows the Fermi slowing-down estimate xi_bar*Sigma_s/Delta_u (xi_H=1, xi_O=0.12). Upscatter is neglected by declaration. The boron dose response is the 10B(n,a) kerma coefficient at a notional dilute 10 ug/g loading basis (Q=2.34 MeV capture energy); 1/v-weighted per group. This is a declared research fixture, not an evaluation-derived library.
